The rejection-rate prior is a calibration prompt, not a target.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-transition-roadmap</b><br>Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>fill order <b>5</b> &middot; type <b>roadmap</b><br>audience <b>mixed</b></div></div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">Use the size band and baseline calibration on sheet 1. Enter planned duration as a range and explain the choice even when adopting the book's band unchanged. Leave provisional calendar dates blank until baseline status is captured and Month 0 is recorded.</div>
  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Phase band — Phase 1 — Pilot <span class="ws-block-note">Typical duration bands vary by org size and documentation maturity</span></h2>
    <table class="ws"><colgroup><col style="width:6%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:36%"><col style="width:36%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">25</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Phase</b></td><td class="prior">Phase 1 — Pilot<span class="prior-src">ch08 L106, L269</span></td><td class="locked">Fixed phase label.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">26</span></td><td><b>Phase band — The book's printed range</b></td><td class="prior"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="book range lookup by phase label; ch08 L84-89">1–5 months</span><span class="prior-src">ch08 L84-89</span></td><td class="locked">Printed from the book.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">27</span></td><td><b>Phase band — The book's band for <i>our</i> org size</b></td><td class="prior">Under 200: 1–3 months; 200–1,000: 3–5 months; 1,000+: 4–6 months.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L108</span></td><td class="locked"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="lookup Phase 1 range using org-size band in calibration field 1; ch08 L108">Use selected org-size band from sheet 1.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">28</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Our planned duration</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill">Range only: <span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">29</span></td><td><b>Phase band — What moved us off the book's band, and why</b></td><td class="prior">A blank is not an answer. Record the rationale whether or not you adopt the book's band.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L76</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Mandatory: explain an override, or why you adopted the book's band unchanged.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">30</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Scale factor</b></td><td class="prior">Documentation maturity. The single biggest driver of Phase 1 duration.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L110</span></td><td class="locked">Printed factor.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">31</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Our reading of that scale factor</b></td><td class="prior">High means the factor will stretch this phase toward the top of our range.</td><td class="fill"><div class="f-hml"><span class="pt">H</span><span class="pt">M</span><span class="pt">L</span></div></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">32</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Objective, one sentence</b></td><td class="prior">Validate that agentic development produces reliable results on your codebase, with your team, under your governance model.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L112</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Confirm verbatim or rewrite in your language.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">33</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Teams entering</b></td><td class="prior">One or two teams scoring "ready".<span class="prior-src">ch08 L114</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Name teams from WS-06-team-readiness-scorecard.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">34</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Team count</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count the named teams in field 33"></span></td></tr>

      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">36</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Coaching load</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="coach count in field 37 compared with team count in field 34"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">37</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Named coaches / enablement function</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>

  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Phase band — Phase 2 — Expand <span class="ws-block-note">Phase 2 duration is measured from project start in the printed range</span></h2>
    <table class="ws"><colgroup><col style="width:6%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:36%"><col style="width:36%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr></thead><tbody>

      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">44</span></td><td><b>Phase band — The book's band for <i>our</i> org size</b></td><td class="prior">Phase 2 itself: under 200: 2–4 months; 200–1,000: 3–6 months; 1,000+: 4–8 months.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L134</span></td><td class="locked"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="lookup Phase 2 range using org-size band in calibration field 1; ch08 L134">Use selected org-size band from sheet 1.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">45</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Our planned duration</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill">Range only: <span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>

      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">47</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Scale factor</b></td><td class="prior">Coaching capacity.       <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">48</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Our reading of that scale factor</b></td><td class="prior">High means the factor will stretch this phase toward the top of our range.</td><td class="fill"><div class="f-hml"><span class="pt">H</span><span class="pt">M</span><span class="pt">L</span></div></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">49</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Objective, one sentence</b></td><td class="prior">Extend adoption while building the organisational infrastructure the pilot didn't require at small scale.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L138</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Confirm verbatim or rewrite in your language.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">50</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Teams entering</b></td><td class="prior">Three to five additional teams, including at least one that scored "partially ready" in one dimension.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L140</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Name teams from WS-06-team-readiness-scorecard.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">51</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Team count</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count the named teams in field 50"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">52</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Phase owner</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">53</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Coaching load</b></td><td class="prior">Peer coaching becomes strained beyond roughly one coach to three expanding teams; dedicated enablement is advised beyond five teams. This is a reported strain point, not a target.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L136</span></td>      <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="coach count in field 54 compared with team count in field 51"></span><span class="prior-src">If the ratio is exceeded, record the funded enablement line (budget owner and amount) in field 54.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">54</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Named coaches / enablement function</b></td><td class="prior">Pilot team members become internal coaches; each expanding team should have access to someone who went through the pilot.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L143</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">55</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Indicative calendar window</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill" style="font-weight:300;opacity:.68">PROVISIONAL — planning horizon, not a schedule.<br>FROM <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div> TO <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div><span class="prior-src">LOCKED until field 6 is captured and field 7 has a date. Otherwise leave blank.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">56</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Gate at the end of this phase</b></td><td class="prior">"Exit signals met?"<span class="prior-src">ch08 L88</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Enter the gate card reference and the named person who calls it.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">57</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Rollback loop</b></td><td class="prior">ROLLBACK: Coach dependency / divergence &rarr; shrink and reinforce<span class="prior-src">ch08 L91, L98-101</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>Rollback loop drawn on the wall</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">58</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Terminator</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="locked">Not the final band.</td></tr>
    </tbody></table>
  </div>

<!-- ============================ SHEET 5 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">
  <div class="ws-head"><div><h1>The Transition Roadmap — Three Phases, Named Teams, Dated Gates</h1><p class="ws-sub">Wall band 4 of 5 &middot; Phase 3 — Scale. This phase moves to an ongoing capability, not a completion date.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-transition-roadmap</b><br>Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>fill order <b>5</b> &middot; type <b>roadmap</b><br>audience <b>mixed</b></div></div>
  <div class="ws-source">Source: <b>Planning the Transition</b>, <i>Phased Adoption</i> &middot; <code>handbook\ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd</code> L72-184 &middot; <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.html#sec-transition-phases">#sec-transition-phases</a></div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">Use the size band and baseline calibration on sheet 1. Enter planned duration as a range and explain the choice even when adopting the book's band unchanged. Name every team, owner, and enablement function. No calendar window before captured baseline and Month 0. The program-improvement criterion below is a suggested, hedged prior; do not treat it as a target. Describe the capability that continues beyond this phase on the Ongoing band.</div>
  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Phase band — Phase 3 — Scale <span class="ws-block-note">No completion date; the steady state is on the following band</span></h2>
    <table class="ws"><colgroup><col style="width:6%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:36%"><col style="width:36%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">59</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Phase</b></td><td class="prior">Phase 3 — Scale<span class="prior-src">ch08 L159, L292</span></td><td class="locked">Fixed phase label.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">60</span></td><td><b>Phase band — The book's printed range</b></td><td class="prior"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="book range lookup by phase label; ch08 L84-89">6–24 months from project start</span><span class="prior-src">ch08 L84-89</span></td><td class="locked">Printed from the book.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">61</span></td><td><b>Phase band — The book's band for <i>our</i> org size</b></td><td class="prior">Under 200: 3–6 months; 200–1,000: 6–12 months; 1,000+: 12–24 months. For 400+ engineers, at least 12 months; for 1,000+, 18–24 months.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L161, L163</span></td><td class="locked"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="lookup Phase 3 range using org-size band in calibration field 1; ch08 L161, L163">Use selected org-size band from sheet 1.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">62</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Our planned duration</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill">Range only: <span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">63</span></td><td><b>Phase band — What moved us off the book's band, and why</b></td><td class="prior">A blank is not an answer. Record the rationale whether or not you adopt the book's band.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L76</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Mandatory: explain an override, or why you adopted the book's band unchanged.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">64</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Scale factor</b></td><td class="prior">Organisational breadth.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L163</span></td><td class="locked">Printed factor.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">65</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Our reading of that scale factor</b></td><td class="prior">High means the factor will stretch this phase toward the top of our range.</td><td class="fill"><div class="f-hml"><span class="pt">H</span><span class="pt">M</span><span class="pt">L</span></div></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">66</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Objective, one sentence</b></td><td class="prior">Make agentic development the default working mode.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L166</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Confirm verbatim or rewrite in your language.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">67</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Teams entering</b></td><td class="prior">Remaining teams, including those initially scoring "not ready" that have since received preparation.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L168</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Name teams from WS-06-team-readiness-scorecard.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">68</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Team count</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count the named teams in field 67"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">69</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Phase owner</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">70</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Coaching load</b></td><td class="prior">Transition from peer coaching to a dedicated enablement function with permanent ownership.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L169</span></td>      <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="coach count in field 71 compared with team count in field 68"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">71</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Named coaches / enablement function</b></td><td class="prior">Phase 3 transitions from peer coaching to a dedicated enablement function with permanent named ownership.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L136, L169</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">72</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Indicative calendar window</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill" style="font-weight:300;opacity:.68">PROVISIONAL — planning horizon, not a schedule.<br>FROM <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div> TO <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div><span class="prior-src">LOCKED until field 6 is captured and field 7 has a date. Otherwise leave blank.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">73</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Gate at the end of this phase</b></td><td class="prior">"Exit signals met?" — Phase 3 does not have an endpoint; the signal is that measurable value is sustained and the transition is an ongoing capability.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L88, L182</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Enter the gate card reference and the named person who calls it.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">74</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Rollback loop</b></td><td class="prior">Selective rollback: pause teams with sustained negative trends; halt further expansion and review if organizational metrics plateau or decline for a full quarter.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L176-179</span>
        <div class="prior--hedged"><span class="hedge-figure">Fewer than 40% of participating teams show measurable improvement on quality or efficiency metrics.</span><span class="hedge-text">(a suggested threshold; adjust based on your organization's risk tolerance)</span><span class="hedge-src">handbook\ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd L180</span></div>
      </td><td class="fill"><div class="ours-label">Our program continuation criterion, measured against our baseline</div><span class="f-box"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">75</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Terminator</b></td><td class="prior">Phase 3 has no endpoint; it is the steady state.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L182</span></td><td class="locked">No end date. Continue into the Ongoing band.</td></tr>
    </tbody></table>
  </div>
  <div class="ws-foot-quote">"This is a planning horizon, not a schedule." (ch04 L252; ch08 L76)</div>

<div class="sheet">
  <div class="ws-head"><div><h1>The Transition Roadmap — Three Phases, Named Teams, Dated Gates</h1><p class="ws-sub">Wall band 5 of 5 &middot; Ongoing. This final band deliberately has no right edge or completion date.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-transition-roadmap</b><br>Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>fill order <b>5</b> &middot; type <b>roadmap</b><br>audience <b>mixed</b></div></div>
  <div class="ws-source">Source: <b>Planning the Transition</b>, <i>Phased Adoption</i> &middot; <code>handbook\ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd</code> L72-184 &middot; <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.html#sec-transition-phases">#sec-transition-phases</a></div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">Name the teams and owner who sustain the work as an ongoing capability. Do not give the Ongoing band an end date. Its provisional window stays blank unless baseline status is captured and Month 0 is recorded. Continue the timeline visually off the right edge when these panels are placed on the wall.</div>
  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Phase band — Ongoing <span class="ws-block-note">Steady state; no endpoint</span></h2>
    <table class="ws"><colgroup><col style="width:6%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:36%"><col style="width:36%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">76</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Phase</b></td><td class="prior">Ongoing<span class="prior-src">ch08 L182; phase label ch08 L303</span></td><td class="locked">Fixed phase label.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">77</span></td><td><b>Phase band — The book's printed range</b></td><td class="prior"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="book range lookup by phase label; ch08 L182">no endpoint</span><span class="prior-src">ch08 L182</span></td><td class="locked">No endpoint.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">78</span></td><td><b>Phase band — The book's band for <i>our</i> org size</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="locked">No org-size duration band for ongoing steady state.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">79</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Our planned duration</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="locked">No planned endpoint or duration.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">80</span></td><td><b>Phase band — What moved us off the book's band, and why</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="locked">No duration band; do not add an end date.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">81</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Scale factor</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="locked">No separate Ongoing scale factor named.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">82</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Our reading of that scale factor</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="locked">Not applicable; no Ongoing scale factor is named.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">83</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Objective, one sentence</b></td><td class="prior">The tools produce measurable value, the organization can sustain and improve that value, and the transition is an ongoing capability.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L182</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Confirm verbatim or rewrite in your language.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">84</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Teams entering</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Name teams sustaining the capability.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">85</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Team count</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="count the named teams in field 84"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">86</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Phase owner</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">87</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Coaching load</b></td><td class="prior">Permanent enablement ownership is established in Phase 3.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L169</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="coach count in field 88 compared with team count in field 85"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">88</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Named coaches / enablement function</b></td><td class="prior">Permanent ownership for context asset quality, onboarding materials and tooling support.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L169</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">89</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Indicative calendar window</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="fill" style="font-weight:300;opacity:.68">PROVISIONAL — planning horizon, not a schedule.<br>FROM <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div> TO <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div><span class="prior-src">LOCKED until field 6 is captured and field 7 has a date. Do not add an end date to the Ongoing band.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">90</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Gate at the end of this phase</b></td><td class="prior">Phase 3 has no endpoint; measurable value is sustained and the transition is an ongoing capability.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L182</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="prior-src">Enter the gate card reference and the named person who calls it.</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">91</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Rollback loop</b></td><td class="prior">—</td><td class="locked">No separate Ongoing rollback loop specified.</td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">92</span></td><td><b>Phase band — Terminator</b></td><td class="prior">Phase 3 has no endpoint; it is the steady state. The timeline ends in an ongoing-capability band, never a completion date.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L182</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="prior-src">Name the capability the organization is becoming. No date.</span></td></tr>
    </tbody></table>

<!-- ============================ SHEET 7 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">
  <div class="ws-head"><div><h1>The Transition Roadmap — Three Phases, Named Teams, Dated Gates</h1><p class="ws-sub">Absorbed sequence &middot; six owned, dated, gated actions before the phase bands.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-transition-roadmap</b><br>Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>fill order <b>5</b> &middot; type <b>roadmap</b><br>audience <b>mixed</b></div></div>
  <div class="ws-source">Roadmap context: <b>Planning the Transition</b>, <i>Phased Adoption</i> &middot; <code>handbook\ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd</code> L72-184 &middot; <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.html#sec-transition-phases">#sec-transition-phases</a>. Action priors: <code>handbook\ch02-the-ai-native-landscape.qmd</code> L216-225.</div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">For each action, name one owner, commit a real date, enter its budget (the first two require no budget or procurement, so record zero or an explicit figure), record prerequisites, and state what unlocks the next action. Work left to right across each row. These six actions form the Pre-Transition sequence.</div>
  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Pre-Transition actions <span class="ws-block-note">absorbed from WS-02-adoption-sequencing-roadmap</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:12%"><col style="width:17%"><col style="width:10%"><col style="width:11%"><col style="width:8%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:16%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th>Pre-Transition actions — Action<br><span class="fno">93</span></th><th>Pre-Transition actions — The book's indicative timing<br><span class="fno">94</span></th><th>Pre-Transition actions — What it requires<br><span class="fno">95</span></th><th>Pre-Transition actions — Owner<br><span class="fno">96</span></th><th>Pre-Transition actions — Committed date<br><span class="fno">97</span></th><th>Pre-Transition actions — Budget<br><span class="fno">98</span></th><th>Pre-Transition actions — Prerequisites<br><span class="fno">99</span></th><th>Pre-Transition actions — Exit criteria that unlock the next action<br><span class="fno">100</span></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="locked"><b>Audit current usage</b><span class="prior-src">ch02 L216-223</span></td><td class="locked">This week<span class="prior-src">ch02 L216-223</span></td><td class="locked">Survey engineering teams and catalogue tools in use.<span class="prior-src">ch02 L216-223</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span><span class="fno">101</span></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div><span class="fno">102</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-currency" data-symbol="&pound;"></span><span class="prior-src">No budget, no procurement; record zero or explicit figure. ch02 L225</span><span class="fno">103</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="fno">104</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="fno">105</span></td></tr>
